blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Sightseeing tour of the city with a guide (3 hours) with an English-speaking guide.

The main attractions of the city include the old district of La Boca, the historic area of the San Telmo district, where you can find a large and small bars, restaurants, as well as an authentic antiques market in Plaza Dorrego.

Also, the main attractions of the city include the "Pink House" (presidential palace Cassa-Rosada), which is associated with the name of Evita Peron, and many other monumental monuments. Among them is the symbol of the city - a 67-meter obelisk erected in honor of the declaration of independence of the state of Argentina, standing on the widest street in the world, Avenue 9 de Julio.  You will also visit the elegant La Recoletta quarter with the famous cemetery, the colonial-style church of El Pilar and the nearby cultural and commercial center. The tour program also includes a visit to the modern areas of the city: Puerto Madero and the parks of Lezama and 3 February.

blocks.text: 7 January. Free day in Buenos Aires

provenance.rationale: Combine the approved date and city heading with the free-day activity stated immediately below it.

blocks.text:
Free days for independent walks and additional excursions:

Excursion in Tigre and through the northern provinces of Buenos Aires. *in a combined group with an English-speaking guide (USD 100 P/P)

The city of Tigre is a mini Venice, a city on the water. It is located 40 km from the center of Buenos Aires. Argentines themselves love to come and relax in this city. During the tour, you will ride through the northern provinces of the city of Buenos Aires. Visit a city called San Isidro, which is considered the richest province and is very different from the capital. After that, your journey will continue in the city of Tigre. Here you will walk along the beautiful historical and board a boat that will take you along the rivers and canals that form the unique river delta of the Tigre. 

Excursion to Montevideo-Uruguay (full day) *in a group with an English-speaking guide (USD 400 P/P), individually (minimum 2 pax) with an English-speaking guide (USD 650 P/P)

Uruguay is a small country in South America, located opposite Buenos Aires on the other side of La Plata Bay. However, despite its modest size, Uruguay is a very successful and dynamically developing country.  This is a country of colonial towns and magnificent beaches! Early in the morning you will be transferred to the port of Buenos Aires, from where you will cross the bay on a special ferry  . On the other side, at the exit, you will be met by a guide who will take you by car to the most interesting places  of the capital of  Uruguay, Montevideo, and discover this country for you. During the excursion you will visit: the Port of Montevideo, Independence Square, the City Center, the Old Town, the Cathedral. After the end of the tour, you will have free time until the departure of the return ferry. Return to Buenos Aires by the same route. Upon arrival at the port, transfer to the hotel. Ferry tickets are included.

"Fiesta Gaucho" (all day) *in a combined group with an English-speaking guide (USD 250 P/P)

The excursion "Fiesta Gaucho" gives you the opportunity to get acquainted with the life and folklore of the Argentine gauchos on one of the ranches located 80 km from the city. Initially nomadic, the gauchos gradually settled down and took up farming and cattle breeding. The few remaining modern gauchos in the country now demonstrate amazing horse skills to everyone. They are distinguished by the ability to throw "boledoras" (with the help of three stones tied with a rope to lasso and immobilize cows), use a knife and lasso, and salt the best meat in the world. Duration: 8 hours (traditional Argentine lunch included).
